title: QAOA reaches the SK ground value when thermodynamic size is taken first
exact_target: For zero-field Gaussian SK, let $Q_p$ be the optimum limiting QAOA energy at fixed depth p after n$\to$infinity. Does $Q_p$ tend as p$\to$infinity to the Parisi ground-state value? Equivalently, for each $\epsilon >0$ must one finite depth and deterministic angle vectors independent of n and disorder achieve limiting value at least $P_*-\epsilon $?
